caption:
Sold horse meat as beef? A Khulna trader now faces 3 months in jail.

A mobile court has sentenced a trader to three months of rigorous imprisonment for selling horse meat as beef in the Kanchanpur area of Dumuria Upazila, Khulna.

The convicted trader, identified as Anisur Rahman Palash, son of the late Lutfor Rahman, was caught red-handed during a raid based on secret information.

Additional Superintendent of Police Jayen Uddin Muhammad Ziyad of the SRB Satkhira Camp mentioned that the trader had been deceiving customers by promoting the meat as beef.

Following the arrest, the executive magistrate of the mobile court delivered the sentence. The seized horse meat was subsequently buried in a hole in public view to destroy it.
